query:
SELECT d.id, d.name, d.firebaseId, d.userId, u.openId
FROM dealers d 
LEFT JOIN users u ON d.userId = u.id 
WHERE d.firebaseId IS NOT NULL AND (u.openId IS NULL OR d.firebaseId != u.openId)
LIMIT 20;
